description: This source file contains internal filename utility functions for the Chromium project, including filename sanitization, extension correction based on MIME types, filename extraction from URLs, and filename generation logic.

methods.name: SanitizeGeneratedFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by trimming trailing dots/spaces and replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: GetFileNameFromURL
methods.description: Extracts filename from URL's last path component, decoding URL encoding and handling query overwrites.

methods.name: IsShellIntegratedExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is integrated into Windows shell (e.g., .lnk, .local, CLSID).

methods.name: EnsureSafeExtension
methods.description: Ensures filename has a safe and appropriate extension based on MIME type, avoiding shell-integration extensions.

methods.name: FilePathToString16
methods.description: Converts a FilePath to a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilenameImpl
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL, content disposition, suggested name, MIME type, and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileNameImpl
methods.description: Creates a filename for download, combining URL, headers, and suggested names into a safe filename.
